integrity: Theorem uses exact stationary renewal and Mellin arguments. Reproducibility script checks finite rational cases and numerical examples; finite checks are not the proof.
scientific_limitations: Two identical unstable independent Gaussian modes, exact observations, symmetric Markov sensor allocation; no general policy optimality or independent scientific verification. Power exponents and criticality have prior theoretical antecedents.
title: Exact log-periodic Gaussian-error tails in two-sensor Kalman scheduling
